notes: Invariant: no change alters any value the search reads. Each item is either (a) avoiding a copy/allocation of a value that is read identically (move borrow on descend, DON_BOX payload built once, candidate ids borrowed, profiles borrowed), (b) replacing a hash function of a lookup-only table (FNV instead of SipHash for uuid/vocab/profile/leader maps; ProfileCache dense index) - same contents, same lookups, or (c) not building output-only JSON that is discarded unread.

(c) detail: Session::discard_events(f) replaces the three search scopes that did swap_events(Vec::new())..swap_events(saved) (mcts descend, leaf_value window resolution, quiesce resolved_branch_values). Inside it push_event is a no-op and the 10 push sites in rules/actions.rs + effects::resolver::push_effect_events + Resolver::action_history entries skip building JSON. Verified: action_events/action_history are read only by state.rs/audit.rs/py_game.rs output paths (never by rules/search/encode); the EFFECT counter used by the on-play scan (resolver::record_effect_event) is still incremented. Real games (py_game apply, golden, audit) never run inside discard_events, so their events are unchanged (golden green).

On-play scan (encode v7): was Session::new(GameState clone + temp DON!!) per hand ON_PLAY card plus one for the playable list; now runs in Session::isolated on the encoding session with a new journaled Undo::DonPush (StateMut::push_don) so the temp DON!! are rolled back. isolated == Session::new view (Replay rng, empty events/shuffled, no effect actor); commits inside fold into the outer transaction (no behaviour depends on journal recording state).

Drains (search/apply.rs and encode/scalars.rs): get_pending_request is read once per iteration and the stop_at_select test uses adapter::selection_branch_exists(pending) (the former encode::scalars::has_selection_branch moved to adapter; it equals selection_moves(..).is_some() branch by branch). get_pending_request only mutates via normalize_battle_phase, which is idempotent, so reading it once before the test equals the old read-after-test.

main_for (on-play scan entry): pending_actor_action(s) == Some((actor, MAIN_ACTION)) instead of building the pending JSON; both functions share the same branches/side effect and only the Main branch yields MAIN_ACTION (no interaction kind's front_action is MAIN_ACTION).
R zero-fill: Ctx::encode_for now fills rel_om/rel_oo zeros only when the net is not rel-ablated; net::nrel reads/length-checks them only when !ablated(rel) (3 read sites, all guarded).

(b) scope decision: Move stays serde_json::Value at the type level. The JSON moves are produced by rules/legal.rs + search/adapter.rs + search/macro.rs (legal generation = WP rs-speed-a) and consumed by rules/actions.rs apply_game_action(&Value) and the py_game boundary; a type-wide struct would rewrite speed-a's files and the rules API. Instead the search hot paths stop creating/copying/comparing JSON: descend borrows the move (no clone per simulation), apply/candidate rows read fields via MoveRef/PayloadRef single-pass views (no per-key SipHash lookups), DON_BOX builds its payloads once. move_sig is only used at the root (merge_worlds, commit replay) and was left as is (not on the per-simulation path).

Not done / handed over (measured with callgrind on 25 decisions of 1x1280, after this WP): passives::resolve_trigger_over spends ~4% in str::contains (rules effects); net tok-cache key hashing with SipHash ~1% and trunk_avx2 zeroed allocations ~2.3% (net = forward side); get_pending_request JSON building ~4.8% incl (rules); encode_rel's leader_act_avail generates the full legal list (~1.2%) and the on-play scan's playable list uses get_legal_actions (~1.8%) - exact replacements need the same error semantics as main_actions, left as is.

Clippy: `cargo clippy -D warnings` reports 2 errors that already exist on the base commit (ops.rs:278 collapsible_match, quiesce.rs priors_keep type_complexity); not part of make test; untouched. My one new lint (let-and-return in mcts descend) was fixed.

Overlap with rs-speed-a (for merging): files touched that speed-a may also touch: search/mcts.rs (descend only), search/quiesce.rs (encode_for, priors_keep candidate rows, resolved_branch_values discard_events), search/adapter.rs (added selection_branch_exists only), search/apply.rs. No change to forward/legal generation.
